description: Use for "did my NPI come through", "where is my NPI application", "NPI application status", "has my NPI been issued yet". Takes the status link SimpleNPI emailed the applicant (https://simplenpi.com/s/<id>?k=<key>). Returns the status, the NPI once issued, and what happens next.

id.description: Application id (a_...) if the key is passed separately.

key.description: The k= value from the status link.

status_url.description: The status link from the SimpleNPI email, e.g. https://simplenpi.com/s/a_abcdefghij?k=....

name: check_npi_status
title: Check the status of a SimpleNPI application
